title: Page 71
transc:
1 pm Beckwith (2)  Washington May 16th 1864
Happy Hannah May Knapp for Chart A new wayne
of Bergen Pedlar ordered here pike I propose to
dismount the summer & send them forward as Star
shall I give the silvers to veteran pekin Peru
of Argus or send them to Negus who asks
for a Seward silvers stanhope Warner from Abel to
Falmouth Can be repaired in Edwards days shall it
be done stanhope Flora quarreled the violets yesterday and
a part of his saint has plumed the Arno
our loss about Austin Dwight in all Yacht A
messenger just arrived from Negus he is at Haxalls
landing on Abbot & has received supplies for Summer
& silvers Wiley Cupid work to Belle Plain tonight


130 pm Sampson Balto  Washn May 16 1864 
For Press Banditti whist at Port Tobacco can march
to Smiths or Acton vernon & be ferried to
Belle plain other whistle R sent from grapes by
whimper to Bell plain walrus India whens arch cmg
